lines.zh: 我一步一寸地跟着，从不跑。
lines.en: I follow inch by inch; I never run.

lines.zh: 脚印留不下，引线在胸口发烫。
lines.en: No footprints behind me, only a fuse burning in my chest.

lines.zh: 你走多快都没用，我认路。
lines.en: Run as fast as you like; I know the way.

lines.zh: 蠕变维度的石头磨平了我的脚。
lines.en: The stone of Creeponia has worn my feet smooth.

lines.zh: 每走三步，我就重新数一次距离。
lines.en: Every three steps, I count the distance again.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只是比你先到。
lines.en: I do not chase. I simply arrive before you.

lines.zh: 火药味跟着我，像影子一样。
lines.en: The smell of gunpowder trails me like a shadow.

lines.zh: 脚步很轻，引线的嘶声不轻。
lines.en: My steps are soft; the hissing fuse is not.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，只为走一条直线。
lines.en: I walk around the rocks only to keep my line straight.

lines.zh: 走慢点，我还没数到十。
lines.en: Slow down. I have not counted to ten yet.

lines.zh: 这双腿只为缩短最后那三步。
lines.en: These legs exist only to shorten the final three steps.

lines.zh: 你回头看我时，我正好在走。
lines.en: When you look back, I am always mid-stride.

lines.zh: 站着也在发热，我停不下来。
lines.en: Even standing I smolder; I cannot stop.

lines.zh: 我在等引线自己想起我来。
lines.en: I am waiting for the fuse to remember me.

lines.zh: 二十五颗心在我胸腔里排队。
lines.en: Twenty-five hearts queue up inside my chest.

lines.zh: 蠕变维度没有风，只有我的呼吸。
lines.en: Creeponia has no wind, only my breathing.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，你听见嘶声了吗。
lines.en: In the quiet, do you hear the hissing?

lines.zh: 我的耐心比引线长一点。
lines.en: My patience is a little longer than my fuse.

lines.zh: 火药在骨头缝里结成了块。
lines.en: Gunpowder has caked in the seams of my bones.

lines.zh: 站着不动，也是一种靠近。
lines.en: Standing still is also a way of closing in.

lines.zh: 我闭一会儿眼，锁还开着。
lines.en: I close my eyes a while; the lock stays open.

lines.zh: 等天黑？这里的天从来不明。
lines.en: Wait for night? The sky here never brightens.

lines.zh: 对上眼了，锁扣就合上。
lines.en: Our eyes meet, and the latch clicks shut.

lines.zh: 你瞳孔里有个小小的火星。
lines.en: There is a small spark in your pupil.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我在记你的脸。
lines.en: Do not blink; I am memorizing your face.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不亮，只是烫。
lines.en: My eyes do not glow. They only burn.

lines.zh: 你看见我胸口那道裂缝了吗。
lines.en: Do you see the crack across my chest?

lines.zh: 直视我，等于按下开关。
lines.en: Looking straight at me is like pressing a switch.

lines.zh: 你眼里的我，比实际近一点。
lines.en: The me in your eyes stands a little closer.

lines.zh: 这一眼之后，你归我追了。
lines.en: After this glance, you are mine to follow.

lines.zh: 我盯人不为吓唬，为校准。
lines.en: I stare not to scare, but to calibrate.

lines.zh: 看够了？那我开始倒数。
lines.en: Finished looking? Then I start counting down.

lines.zh: 疼，但引线没断。
lines.en: It hurts, but the fuse held.

lines.zh: 你砍偏了，我的心在更里面。
lines.en: You missed; my heart sits deeper in.

lines.zh: 这一下让我更想靠近你。
lines.en: That blow only makes me want to get closer.

lines.zh: 血？我流的是火药渣。
lines.en: Blood? What I leak is powder grit.

lines.zh: 别停，我正数到一半。
lines.en: Do not stop; I was halfway through counting.

lines.zh: 疼会让我走快一点。
lines.en: Pain makes me walk a little faster.

lines.zh: 你的剑上有我的硝味了。
lines.en: Your blade smells of my saltpeter now.

lines.zh: 我还站着，锁还开着。
lines.en: I am still standing, and the lock is still open.

lines.zh: 这伤不致命，只是吵。
lines.en: This wound is not fatal, only loud.

lines.zh: 再砍两下，我就要提前了。
lines.en: Two more cuts and I will go early.

lines.zh: 面包？我胃里装的是火药。
lines.en: Bread? My stomach is packed with gunpowder.

lines.zh: 你举着胡萝卜，我只闻到硝味。
lines.en: You raise a carrot; I only smell saltpeter.

lines.zh: 喂我之前，先想想我的用途。
lines.en: Before you feed me, think about what I am for.

lines.zh: 我从不吃饭，我只吃距离。
lines.en: I never eat meals. I eat distance.

lines.zh: 我没有舌头，闻得到也尝不到。
lines.en: I have no tongue; I smell it and taste nothing.

lines.zh: 别拿食物换命，我这边不收。
lines.en: Do not trade food for your life; I take none.

lines.zh: 小麦、鱼、肉，全都不顶用。
lines.en: Wheat, fish, meat — none of it works on me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，不是为了吃的。
lines.en: I follow you, and not for a meal.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我就从上面走过去。
lines.en: Set it down; I will simply walk over it.

lines.zh: 诱惑我这门生意，早就不做了。
lines.en: Luring me is a trade I quit long ago.

lines.zh: 撞上了，我胸口先响。
lines.en: We collide, and my chest sounds first.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我怕忍不住。
lines.en: Do not press so close; I might not hold back.

lines.zh: 这一下算你替我点了火。
lines.en: That bump counts as you lighting me.

lines.zh: 我的皮比看上去硬，像铁盒。
lines.en: My hide is harder than it looks, like an iron box.

lines.zh: 退开三步，还能再谈。
lines.en: Step back three paces and we can still talk.

lines.zh: 碰我一下，引线就短一截。
lines.en: One touch, and my fuse is shorter by a notch.

lines.zh: 你撞得我晃，锁没松。
lines.en: You rocked me, but the lock held.

lines.zh: 挤过来做什么，路那么宽。
lines.en: Why crowd me? The road is wide.

lines.zh: 我在你身上留了一股硝味。
lines.en: I left a smell of saltpeter on you.

lines.zh: 相撞的声音，比嘶声好听。
lines.en: The sound of impact beats the hissing.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是那声巨响。
lines.en: My partner is that one great bang.

lines.zh: 没有同类愿意靠近我，正常。
lines.en: No kin of mine comes close. That is normal.

lines.zh: 想看我成双？去数引线吧。
lines.en: Want to see me paired? Go count fuses.

lines.zh: 我出生那天，就注定独自结束。
lines.en: The day I was born, I was meant to end alone.

lines.zh: 两只追踪者相遇，只会互相点燃。
lines.en: Two trackers meeting only set each other off.

lines.zh: 我不需要伴，只需要终点。
lines.en: I need no companion, only an endpoint.

lines.zh: 别给我找对象，我会带她一起炸。
lines.en: Do not find me a mate; I would take her into the blast.

lines.zh: 同族见面，点个头就走。
lines.en: Kin meet, nod once, and move on.

lines.zh: 孤独是我最省火药的活法。
lines.en: Solitude is how I save the most gunpowder.

lines.zh: 爱情？我只有一根引线。
lines.en: Love? I have only one fuse.

lines.zh: 我连手都没有，怎么捡。
lines.en: I have no hands. How would I pick it up?

lines.zh: 掉落的火药？那本来是我的。
lines.en: Dropped gunpowder? That was mine to begin with.

lines.zh: 你掉的剑，我踩过去就好。
lines.en: Your dropped sword — I will just walk over it.

lines.zh: 我没有口袋，只有一肚子火。
lines.en: I have no pockets, only a belly full of fire.

lines.zh: 别把东西丢在我脚边，会烧掉。
lines.en: Do not drop things at my feet; they burn.

lines.zh: 捡不起来，我干脆绕开。
lines.en: I cannot pick it up, so I walk around it.

lines.zh: 谁掉的火药，闻着像亲戚。
lines.en: Someone dropped gunpowder; it smells like family.

lines.zh: 空着手追人，才跑得快。
lines.en: Chasing empty-handed is what keeps me fast.

lines.zh: 那块铁我踢了两下，没捡。
lines.en: I kicked that iron twice and left it.

lines.zh: 我唯一带走的东西，是你。
lines.en: The only thing I take away is you.

lines.zh: 锁定了，扣子咔的一声。
lines.en: Locked on. The catch clicks once.

lines.zh: 从这一秒起，你在我名单上。
lines.en: From this second, you are on my list.

lines.zh: 你跑动的样子，帮我定了位。
lines.en: The way you run fixed your position for me.

lines.zh: 不用望远镜，我认气息。
lines.en: No spyglass needed; I know your scent.

lines.zh: 目标确认，引线开始算账。
lines.en: Target confirmed. The fuse starts its accounting.

lines.zh: 我选你，不是因为你弱。
lines.en: I chose you, and not because you are weak.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味最好认。
lines.en: The iron smell on you is the easiest to follow.

lines.zh: 别躲树后，树挡不住我。
lines.en: Do not hide behind that tree; it will not stop me.

lines.zh: 名字不重要，位置重要。
lines.en: Your name does not matter. Your position does.

lines.zh: 追你这件事，我很有天分。
lines.en: Following you is something I am gifted at.

lines.zh: 从人群里挑出你，只要一秒。
lines.en: Picking you out of the crowd takes one second.

lines.zh: 你刚才那声咳嗽，暴露了。
lines.en: That cough just gave you away.

lines.zh: 锁扣已合，退路我封了。
lines.en: The latch is shut. I have closed your way back.

lines.zh: 开始吧，我数你，不数羊。
lines.en: Let us begin. I count you, not sheep.

lines.zh: 你留的脚印，比路标还清楚。
lines.en: Your footprints are clearer than any signpost.

lines.zh: 我不急，锁上了就慢慢来。
lines.en: No hurry; once locked, I take my time.

lines.zh: 嘶——这段声音你熟吗。
lines.en: Hsss. Do you know this sound by now?

lines.zh: 还有十步，我走得很稳。
lines.en: Ten steps left, and my pace is steady.

lines.zh: 引线在缩短，你的时间也是。
lines.en: The fuse shortens, and so does your time.

lines.zh: 别急，爆炸前我喜欢慢慢来。
lines.en: No rush. Before the blast, I like to take it slow.

lines.zh: 你在退，我在算你退多远。
lines.en: You retreat; I measure how far.

lines.zh: 火药开始发热了，你听见没。
lines.en: The powder is warming. Do you hear it?

lines.zh: 我把手指按在胸口，倒数开始。
lines.en: I press a hand to my chest; the count begins.

lines.zh: 你越慌，我越不用跑。
lines.en: The more you panic, the less I need to run.

lines.zh: 这一路我只看你，不看路。
lines.en: All this way I watch you, never the road.

lines.zh: 三、二……我改主意了，再等等。
lines.en: Three, two — I changed my mind. A while longer.

lines.zh: 你背后那堵墙，帮了我。
lines.en: That wall behind you is helping me.

lines.zh: 我不喊口号，嘶声就够了。
lines.en: I shout no slogans; the hissing is enough.

lines.zh: 近了，我的皮开始透红。
lines.en: Closer now; my hide is turning red.

lines.zh: 最后几步，我走得最慢。
lines.en: In the last few steps, I walk the slowest.

lines.zh: 你的影子在墙上，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw your shadow on the wall.

lines.zh: 我每一步都踩在你踩过的地方。
lines.en: I put each foot where yours has been.

lines.zh: 引线声很小，风比它响。
lines.en: The fuse is quiet; the wind is louder.

lines.zh: 你躲进废墟，废墟我很熟。
lines.en: You hide in the ruins, and I know the ruins.

lines.zh: 我数着剩下的距离，不到十步。
lines.en: I count what distance remains: under ten paces.

lines.zh: 你若回头，会看见我在笑。
lines.en: If you look back you will see me smiling.

lines.zh: 碰到你了，火已经点上。
lines.en: I have touched you, and the fire is lit.

lines.zh: 这一撞，是我全部的礼貌。
lines.en: This blow is all the courtesy I have.

lines.zh: 别推开我，会提前的。
lines.en: Do not shove me away; it will go off early.

lines.zh: 你听见我胸腔里那声闷响吗。
lines.en: Did you hear that thud inside my chest?

lines.zh: 我贴住你，就不松手了。
lines.en: Once I am against you, I do not let go.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我们都别想干净。
lines.en: One boom, and neither of us stays clean.

lines.zh: 我用整副身体打你这一下。
lines.en: I strike this blow with my whole body.

lines.zh: 碎屑里有我的火药，也有你的。
lines.en: The debris holds my gunpowder and yours.

lines.zh: 这一下之后，我少了一半。
lines.en: After that blow, half of me is gone.

lines.zh: 你砍我，我照样往前撞。
lines.en: Cut me, and I still lunge forward.

lines.zh: 最后的力气都给了这声巨响。
lines.en: My last strength went into that roar.

lines.zh: 别看我散架了，效果到了。
lines.en: Do not mind that I am scattered; it worked.

lines.zh: 护甲挡得住撞击，挡不住火。
lines.en: Armor stops the impact, not the fire.

lines.zh: 下次见面，我会记得你怕这个。
lines.en: Next time, I will remember you fear this.

lines.zh: 我抱住你，火光从缝里冒。
lines.en: I hold on to you and firelight leaks out.

lines.zh: 这一声很闷，因为离得太近。
lines.en: The sound is muffled because we are so close.

lines.zh: 我的碎块落进你的领口。
lines.en: My pieces fall inside your collar.

lines.zh: 你砍得再准，也拦不住引线。
lines.en: Strike true all you like; the fuse keeps burning.

lines.zh: 手还没松开，就已经炸了。
lines.en: My hands had not let go before it went off.

lines.zh: 下次我会站在更远的地方看。
lines.en: Next time I will watch from farther away.

lines.zh: 从蠕变维度的石缝里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a crack in Creeponia's stone.

lines.zh: 睁眼第一件事：找最近的人。
lines.en: First thing I do awake: find the nearest person.

lines.zh: 我生下来就带着一根短引线。
lines.en: I was born with a short fuse.

lines.zh: 这里的空气是酸的，我习惯了。
lines.en: The air here is sour. I am used to it.

lines.zh: 影子先落地，我才跟上。
lines.en: My shadow lands first; then I follow.

lines.zh: 谁把我叫醒的？站远点。
lines.en: Who woke me? Stand back.

lines.zh: 刚长齐的皮，还没被烧过。
lines.en: My hide just finished growing and has not been burned yet.

lines.zh: 我叫追踪者，因为我只做这件事。
lines.en: They call me a tracker because that is all I do.

lines.zh: 出生地不重要，猎物才重要。
lines.en: Birthplace means nothing; prey means everything.

lines.zh: 五十点血，够我走完这一趟。
lines.en: Fifty points of health is enough for this walk.

lines.zh: 硫磺味是我的胎记。
lines.en: The smell of sulfur is my birthmark.

lines.zh: 别围过来看，我害羞，会响。
lines.en: Do not crowd around. I get shy, and I go off.

lines.zh: 火？我本来就是点着的。
lines.en: Fire? I was already lit.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，火药在肚子里晃。
lines.en: Falling from a height shakes the powder in my belly.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，引线还在烧。
lines.en: I sink, and the fuse keeps burning.

lines.zh: 自己的响，把自己也炸懵了。
lines.en: My own blast left me stunned too.

lines.zh: 箭插在我身上，像根新引线。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in me like a second fuse.

lines.zh: 这股味道，比火药冲。
lines.en: This reek is sharper than gunpowder.

lines.zh: 饿不死我，我吃的是空气。
lines.en: Hunger cannot kill me; I eat air.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我以为是我自己响的。
lines.en: Thunder struck, and I thought it was me.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我连响都没响成。
lines.en: Falling into the void, I never even got to boom.
